status: Controller authoring forecast; not independently reviewed, human-accepted or implementation-ready. The canonical delivery inventory is the F/G engineering section of MULTI_IDENTITY_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; this JSON is its sizing projection.
unit: Added or rewritten handwritten physical LF lines, including comments and blanks. Count moved code at destination; do not subtract deletions. Report deletions and mechanical moves separately. Production/configuration and tests/fixtures are separate; prose, generated files, dependencies and observations are excluded.
confidence: Conditional, with lowest confidence in code-closure, effective-policy and native platform proofs. A failing mechanism proof returns to engineering before dependent implementation; ranges are not budgets or measured results.

slices.title: Prove the managed-data and immutable-code boundary
slices.owns: Reuse conservative image projection and shadow/ancestor controls; qualify confined descriptors and trusted artifact/source lifetime races on eligible engine.
slices.check: Mapped empty/absent destinations work, populated writable ones refuse under RO root, trusted paths remain protected with RW root; ordinary behavior unchanged. Broader restrictions/weaker guarantees return to design.

slices.title: Declare managed metadata and intrinsic root policy
slices.owns: Accepted owner/group/permissions and separate relative directories/files maps. Intrinsic root defaults read-only, with explicit environment.mounts.root writable policy. Preserve ordinary omitted-field identity.
slices.check: Resolve contextual owners and primary groups, reject unsafe paths/unknown principals before effects, bind the root policy canonically without admitting an external bind over /.

slices.title: Bind image-destination projection to the generation
slices.owns: Bounded metadata projection within verified immutable-image stream; canonical mapped-only build-lock evidence, validation/publication and exact reuse. No launch-time full export or separate authority store.
slices.check: Layer/alias/whiteout/type controls and aggregate limits/cancellation; missing/stale/forged evidence refuses, ordinary omitted-field bytes stable, host admission remains independent.

slices.title: Prepare declared objects through pinned descriptors
slices.owns: Descriptor-relative inert directory/file creation and existing-object verification, parent-first directories then files. No symlink/mount crossing, alias/type substitution, recursive ownership repair or application code.
slices.check: Exact declared metadata succeeds; substitution, hardlink and foreign-tree races leave protected targets unchanged. Count shared adversarial fixtures here once.

slices.title: Confine preparation to selected subordinate authority
slices.owns: Reviewed setup-helper invocation with freshly validated selected geometry, pinned handoff descriptors, numeric ownership and bounded cancellation. Reuse existing mapping/writer authority.
slices.check: Private subordinate ownership and recipient access work without host-root/operator aliases, unrelated mutations, application execution or a surviving privileged helper. The earlier namespace/file probe is partial feasibility evidence only.

slices.title: Record storage ownership and exclusive preparation
slices.owns: Managed resource identities and preparation/attachment inhibition in the existing transaction. Capture selected handles, revisions and pending effects; no independent resource registry.
slices.check: Concurrent attach/prepare and stale geometry refuse before writes; crashes retain exact ownership and reservations. A process exit or API success alone cannot prove an unattached resource.

slices.title: Fence recovery owners before protected storage effects
slices.owns: Exact retirement and restart-owner fence contract consumed by later controller adapters. Keep the operation lock out of external manager-stop waits; require fresh retirement observations before preparation.
slices.check: No registered engine/controller owner can recreate during preparation or undo stop/revocation. Lost observation retains inhibition; retained application data and reservations remain intact.

slices.title: Prove eligible rootless network and effective observation
slices.owns: Disposable proof on an E-compatible rootless Podman path: trusted pre-release setup, namespace-pinned effective rules, DNS, private peer boundary and endpoint transport. Establish which final capabilities preserve that boundary.
slices.check: Positive allowed egress/endpoints and direct peer, gateway and IPv6 negatives with exact cleanup. Existing C patched-guest and ordinary Docker results do not close this gate. Failure blocks dependent code rather than weakening policy.

slices.title: Prepare trusted network policy before mapped release
slices.owns: Move only trusted policy setup before the release wait, using the frozen plan and existing nftables installer. Keep application execution after the host gate and final native transition; do not copy the installer.
slices.check: Effective setup exists while payload is inhibited; failure/timeout never releases the application; no setup network authority survives the final transition.

slices.title: Supply production mount and kernel sandbox observations
slices.owns: Replace the private complete-code-closure placeholder with the locked bounded image-destination projection and actual complete root/mount/source/kernel observations. Protect the generation-verified top-level verifier bind even with writable root; no general executable classifier.
slices.check: Exact process/namespace/source/root-policy and effective-kernel controls; stale/substituted/unplanned mounts, missing projection and writable image-shadow refuse. Explicit root mutation never exposes trusted Reploy code.

slices.title: Enforce private installation network boundaries
slices.owns: Canonical private namespace/attachment shape, resolver and host-gateway handling, public/local/ambiguous policy and capability-conditioned refusals. No shared private network or implicit peer reachability.
slices.check: Selected transport preserves intended allowed traffic and denies undeclared TCP/UDP/abstract-socket peers. Unsupported capability or transport combinations fail explicitly before effects.

slices.title: Publish and observe only declared endpoints
slices.owns: Typed create/inspect endpoint fields, staged/deployed port selection and exact network/publication ownership and cleanup.
slices.check: Only declared addresses/ports are reachable; mismatched publication blocks payload. Partial teardown retains uncertainty and never removes a foreign object.

slices.title: Qualify storage and network together
slices.owns: Integrated exact/bounded preparation, attachment, effective sandbox, network, endpoint and failure evidence on the qualified engine. Reuse child fixtures without repeating their entire test inventory.
slices.check: Observable supported-boundary filesystem/network positives and refusal/no-mutation negatives close F's parent obligations; injected fixtures alone do not.

slices.title: Prove controller transport and interrupted startup boundaries
slices.owns: Bounded disposable direct wait/attach/EOF/cancellation and mapped private-input feasibility. Reuse the successful WSL Docker wait proof; add missing Podman and native transport evidence where load-bearing.
slices.check: Exact exit status, no duplicate/foreign start, private input confinement and no setup descriptors/authority at exec. Missing native tests remain named adapter readiness gates; no false universal qualification.

slices.title: Select phase mappings under the Podman input
slices.owns: Direct schema-1 relocation and staging/deployed selection through existing typed whole-array overrides. Update all consumers and retained-state guards; no mapping-specific install flags.
slices.check: Correct phase/override precedence, strict existing override decoding and whole-array replacement; no old undeployed mapping path, source-sidecar adoption, fallback profile or declaration-removal bypass.

slices.title: Connect approved identity maintenance commands
slices.owns: Public check/configure/status/recover wiring to delivered identity operations with bounded contexts, diagnostics and held-lock authority. Reuse approved command contracts.
slices.check: Actual commands reach existing operations; pending/dormant/revoked state stays authoritative; commands do not launch payload or adopt copied state.

slices.title: Install an independent destination owner
slices.owns: Destination-local override snapshot under paired operation locks, independent mapping decision, publication/build reuse, overlap/revision checks and partial-install recovery. Existing staging loader is not installed support.
slices.check: Staging and user install have separate reservations; source state/data remain unchanged. Never copy source pending operations, admission, managed ownership or secrets.

slices.title: Declare Reploy restart policy and durable controller state
slices.owns: Restart policy and legacy conflict checks; current activation intent/epoch, independent observed manager enablement, controller lease and durable attempt/retry accounting. No permanent up/down preference or parallel enablement authority.
slices.check: Start/stop and enable/disable are independent. Controller recovery preserves activation stop and retry allowance; actual enabled boot/login or explicit start can establish a new activation after recovery. Security inhibition survives all activations.

slices.title: Produce trusted mapped startup-completion evidence
slices.owns: Managed per-attempt exec-status FIFO/header/unlink; qualified raw CLOEXEC tail/fixed errno; exact post-EOF kernel live-image observation bound to existing process/lifecycle ownership. No tracer, resident helper or app marker.
slices.check: Both-profile/native-tuple real startup, same-binary, errno/cancel/kill/exit-race, object substitution and private-fd controls. EOF or engine running alone cannot promote startup; old E evidence not relabelled; guard remains if proof unavailable.

slices.title: Recover workloads through the shared controller loop
slices.owns: Adapt the existing runner for qualified user ownership, host-manager/workload failure separation, policy/backoff, exact reattachment and interrupted-attempt recovery. No persistent approval file or secret snapshot.
slices.check: Confirmed surviving processes are observed without reinjection; failed mapped instances retire before fresh admission. Lost engine observation never implies death or authorizes a second workload.

slices.title: Wait on the engine without a persistent Docker CLI child
slices.owns: Narrow in-process wait using existing local Unix/named-pipe dialers, pinned endpoint/API version, bounded result decoding and request/body cancellation. Retain short-lived CLI operations where appropriate.
slices.check: Preserve actual exit status and error distinction; disconnect/cancel releases resources and triggers checked reconciliation. Compare whole-process-tree idle memory, not just a minimal probe binary.

slices.title: Replace lifetime stream children with bounded direct attachment
slices.owns: Reuse PTY transport and add only required non-TTY framing, incremental stdout/stderr handling, stdin half-close, backpressure and independent exit observation. Preserve attach-before-payload ordering.
slices.check: Large/slow streams have bounded buffers; EOF is not exit status; actual stdin/cancellation and exact cleanup survive on supported transports. Preserve the separately delivered RDA hotfix contract.

slices.title: Integrate private input with the mapped final transition
slices.owns: Distinct private preamble before unchanged E release and application stdin; reuse bounded parser/descriptor reader and native mapped exec. Transfer intent follows admission; original deadline, no stronger occupied exec, no retained secret snapshot.
slices.check: One accepted recipient/process receives dummy input exactly once; other roles/transient commands do not. Interrupted transfer retires safely; final descriptors, credentials and capabilities remain correct before enabling the guarded path.

slices.title: Install and control the Linux user controller
slices.owns: Per-installation systemd user adapter, embedded executable/account/endpoint binding, checked stop rather than raw Compose, readiness and removal. Reuse system-unit rendering without granting mapped system scope.
slices.check: Actual user lifecycle and engine readiness; explicit manager/lingering prerequisites and WSL distribution limits. No auto elevation, hidden host configuration or fallback recovery owner.

slices.title: Add the macOS user controller adapter
slices.owns: Per-installation launchd user adapter for the common ordinary-workload controller: install/control, account/session binding, engine/VM readiness and removal. No system backend or mapped macOS promise.
slices.check: Native user login/logout, controller failure, explicit stop, update/removal and engine recovery. An unqualified adapter cannot accept the new public Reploy restart field by silently delegating it.

slices.title: Add the native Windows user controller adapter
slices.owns: Per-installation Task Scheduler user adapter, exact executable/identity, process lifetime/duplicate-instance settings, controller recovery and removal. Reuse native pipe/file validation; no Windows system service or mapped runtime expansion.
slices.check: Actual native Desktop Linux-engine lifecycle, quoting/paths, controller death, stop intent, login and removal. No default task duration termination, duplicate controller or claims based on WSL tests.

slices.title: Connect checked persistent controls and replacement
slices.owns: Checked up/down/restart/status/log/health and existing enable/disable control surface, hooks/readiness, exact replacement, activation-scoped stop and independent manager enablement. No silent legacy migration.
slices.check: Up requires actual startup/handoff and does not enable; enable/disable do not start/stop. No duplicate injection, manager-stop deadlock, recovery-policy bypass or unqualified mapped path.

slices.title: Connect fresh commands and tests with their existing semantics
slices.owns: Actual staged/test/hook/deployed command adapters and correct fresh-container classification. Preserve stdin/EOF/TTY, role and output/status semantics; no default raw-shell role or unqualified occupied exec.
slices.check: Supported command journeys use the common complete gate; actual unqualified host-native/occupied/shared-session paths refuse before effects. Enum names cannot misclassify ordinary fresh deployed commands.

slices.title: Qualify common controller behavior on supported hosts
slices.owns: Native Linux user/system ordinary, WSL, native Windows user and macOS user manager/session qualification with actual supported engines. System-scope mapped remains refused. Shared state tests are reused, not counted again.
slices.check: Install/start/stop/restart/update/rollback/remove, controller crash, engine outage and host/session activation evidence with exact versions/locations, retained data and full process-tree memory/CPU observations. Unsupported combinations remain explicit.

slices.title: Revoke active runtime while retaining ownership
slices.owns: Active revocation composition, stopped/inhibited intent, every registered retry/replacement fence, exact stop/removal and retained mapping/data state.
slices.check: Success means runtime retired and no recovery owner can restart it. Later admission rejects; data/reservations remain. Ambiguous cleanup cannot report revocation success.

slices.title: Reconcile interrupted activation and exact cleanup
slices.owns: Complete pending-operation matrix across install, preparation, admission, private transfer, replacement, manager effects, revocation and network cleanup. Reuse B recovery and existing ownership checks.
slices.check: Each interruption has one supported safe continuation. No stale PID/copied receipt/name-only object authorizes adoption, duplicate start, data deletion or reservation release.

slices.title: Qualify the complete public multi-identity launch path
slices.owns: Source-bound public exact/bounded stage/build/configure/run/test/install/start/retry/stop/revoke journeys and full refusal/cleanup matrix. Close every generic-launch row through supported interfaces.
slices.check: No public guard opens before all required positive and negative evidence passes. Require every exact-head CI job and the separate remote reviews; injected/cross-build/WSL results cannot substitute for unavailable native qualifications.
